title: Rank of a finite matrix over a field
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $m,n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, and $A=(a_{ij})$ an $m\times n$ matrix with entries in $K$ [def-weil-matrix]. The rank of $A$ is the dimension [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] of the $K$-linear span in $K^n$ of its $m$ rows. It equals the dimension of the span in $K^m$ of its $n$ columns, and it is the largest $k$ such that some $k\times k$ square submatrix of $A$ has nonzero determinant.
